_description: Agentloop host eBPF AgentSight (input_agentsight). Names are product-fixed. Empty ProbeConfig uses collector built-in cmdline/HTTPS lists. Not OBI/OTLP. Source: Agentloop eBPF Runtime confirm-access (obviz-integration) + loongcollector docs/cn/plugins/input/native/input_agentsight.md.
_lock_hint: If this config already exists, treat as success and do NOT overwrite. Bind to the user-selected machine group only when get-applied-configs does not already list it.
_probe_hint: Omit ProbeConfig keys to keep collector defaults (9 cmdline + 7 HTTPS hosts from AgentsightManager.cpp). Filling a list replaces that list entirely. Https only attaches processes; it does not filter reported traffic. See references/input-agentsight.md.
_mask_hint: Default processors is []. Data masking is NOT ProbeConfig: set desensitize=true to append the fixed processor_spl (mode=buildin, not builtin). Script is not user-editable.
_version_hint: Requires LoongCollector >= 3.3.9 and Linux kernel >= 5.10 (SLS help). Resolve machines[].binary before apply. Do not set RawHttpsFallback on this default template.
_index_hint: Pilot EnableProductLog for agentloop.ebpf_event creates ebpf-event (+ index). This template does not create ProductLog or indexes. Do not rename dotted gen_ai.* fields.
